answer: Pseudonym parties plus square-root payout: every 30 epochs all operators join a short live party held at the same UTC hour worldwide and receive one fresh operator token; agents under one token split rewards scaled by sqrt(N). A 1,000-agent farm on one token earns ~32 shares, not 1,000, and faking 1,000 tokens needs 1,000 humans present at once (~$20 each, $20,000 per round). The beacon rotates venues like Pearl Street, Willow Park and Yarrow Hall so none can be pre-staffed.
